Procedure title: Provision of Lone Worker Devices and a Response Centre
Description: The device must be robust enough to withstand normal wear and tear in an industrial environment. The device must be lightweight, portable and must include a holder to carry the device on your person, easily accessible and CE compliant. A sample device must be provided to examine these features with tender. The device must be water resistant (e.g. IP67). The device must have a minimum 50 hour plus duration of battery life in normal operational use per single charge. Please note a monthly email is required outlining incidents in previous month. The Tenderer will be required to outline the lone working system administration requirements. Preference given to tenders minimizing end user administration for Wexford County Council.
